meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先派出子代理查文档,再按阶段给出实施计划;每阶段写明要参考的文档、验证清单和避免的反模式,最后统一检查。
howto.when: 当要求规划功能、任务或多步实施时触发,尤其在使用 do 执行之前。若计划源于 bug 或功能积压,会先走 oh-my-issues 归类。

say.text: 帮我规划给现有 API 加分页参数的功能。
say.note: 先派子代理查文档,再产出分阶段计划。

say.text: 我要分三步重构登录模块,先出计划再执行。
say.note: 计划会包含每步的验证清单和反模式提醒。

say.text: 帮我规划这个 bug 的修复,先走 oh-my-issues 归类。
say.note: 会先聚类问题再生成计划。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude dispatches subagents to discover docs, then produces a phased plan. Each phase gives doc references, a verification checklist, and anti-pattern guards, ending with a final verification.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially before executing with do. If the plan stems from a bug or backlog item, it routes through oh-my-issues first.

say_en.text: Help me plan adding pagination to the existing API.
say_en.note: It will discover docs first, then produce a phased plan.

say_en.text: I want to refactor the login module in three steps; make a plan before executing.
say_en.note: Each step will include a verification checklist and anti-pattern tips.

say_en.text: Plan a fix for this bug; route it through oh-my-issues first.
say_en.note: It will cluster root causes, then generate the plan.
